462727591606874112.bio: Won the whole thing in year one at 11-3 with the most points in the league, then went 10-4 and took third. Owns the longest win streak in league history — ten straight — and the best career win rate anyone will ever post (.750), mostly because he left after two seasons and took it with him. Also, inexplicably, holds the lowest single-week score ever recorded: 54.86.

469223780661587968.bio: More regular-season wins than anyone alive (44) and a playoff berth in every season he has played. He has nothing to show for it: no titles, no points crowns, and a 3-5 record once January arrives. Has never finished worse than 8-6, which is its own kind of prison. The team names track the mood — 'What the folk' became 'First round exit' became 'Fire patullo'.

869712074853523456.bio: Arrived in 2023, went 7-7, went 7-7 again, then posted the best record in the league in 2025 at 10-4 — and ran straight into a 190-point buzzsaw in the final. Two years treading water, one year proving it. Still hunting the ring.

471856560138612736.bio: Four playoff trips in five years and a runner-up finish in 2022, but the record book remembers the cruelty: he owns both the most points ever scored in a loss (156.18) and the fewest ever scored in a win (76.23). Nobody in this league has been jerked around by the schedule more.

471861310779289600.bio: Best playoff record in league history at 6-2. Went 7-7 in the 2023 regular season, snuck into the bracket, and won the title anyway. Third in 2021, champion in 2023, then two straight years watching from home — but if he gets in, somebody good is going out.

470142073480146944.bio: Put together the greatest regular season this league has ever seen — 13-1 and 1,948 points in 2023 — and lost the final. Two points titles, in 2022 and 2023, and still no ring to show for either. Then the floor gave way: back-to-back 4-10 seasons, one of them behind a team he named 'The Bottom'.

467208097522249728.bio: Exactly .500 for his career at 35-35, which hides how violent the swings are. Runner-up in 2021, two losing seasons in the middle, then a 10-4 championship in 2024 where he also led the league in scoring and dropped the highest single-week total in league history: 199.6. Followed it up at 6-8. Still owes the league a Sports Illustrated photoshoot for losing 2020.

596866955470757888.bio: Two seasons: a 9-5 playoff team, then a 5-9 collapse that ended in the 2022 shit bowl. Paid the debt in full with a bikini carwash — completed, documented, and then he was gone.

472107756912898048.bio: Two Sleeper seasons, 8-6 and then 6-8, one playoff appearance and no hardware, behind a team called 'Rub My Chubb'. His real mark on this league came earlier: he lost in 2019 and served the sentence on an open mic — which is more than several men on this list can say.

471865126467661824.bio: Five seasons, 35-35, and not one honor of any kind — no titles, no points crowns, not even a shit bowl. And yet he owns both extremes of the record book: the biggest blowout ever (102.96 points over chrishen95) and the closest game ever played, a 0.07-point escape in week 1 of 2021. The margins find him even when the trophies do not.

596864194553368576.bio: Opened his career 5-9 and 6-8 in the 14-team era with nothing to show for it, then flipped the whole thing over: 9-5, 8-6, 7-7, three straight playoff trips and third place in 2024. Nobody in this league has improved more.

595734764493791232.bio: A losing career record (19-23) and two third-place finishes, which should not be possible. Went 8-6, then 4-10, then 7-7, and converted two of those into podiums on the back of a 4-2 playoff record. Also the only manager in league history who has never once renamed his team.

472225780726755328.bio: Went 2-12 in 2022, owns the longest losing streak on record at eight games, and sang karaoke at an NBA game for losing the 2023 shit bowl. Then: runner-up in 2024, and a 2025 championship where he led the league in points and hung 190.86 in the final — the highest playoff score ever recorded here. Somehow still carries a losing career record. Worth it.

596094153587216384.bio: Has reached the playoffs exactly once in five Sleeper seasons. He won it — 3-0, a perfect postseason, 2022 champion. The rest of the résumé reads 4-10, 7-7, 7-7, 5-9, and before any of it he lost 2018 and went clubbing in a dress. Nobody else owns both ends of this league.

596415949872091136.bio: Two seasons, 6-8 both times, no playoff appearances, and the loser of the league's very first shit bowl. Sentenced to 24 hours in a Waffle House, declined to serve it, and was removed from the league. His punishment is still on the books as uncompleted.

869377838724317184.bio: Joined in 2024 and immediately won the shit bowl. Then defended the crown in 2025. 9-19 across two seasons while conceding 1,682 points a year — nearly 200 more than he scores. Did finish the 1,000-piece puzzle in a closet with a headlamp; still owes the league 30 TikToks from 2024.

706842538031554560.bio: 11-31 across three seasons, never a playoff appearance, and the worst season anybody has ever put up here: 1-13 in 2023. Faced more points against per season (1,699) than any manager in league history, including the 163.89 that zichen225 dropped on him in 2022. Left after 2023.
